blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–TNT marched on to the semifinals of the PBA Governors’ Cup after finishing off Magnolia, 98-87, on Saturday for a sweep of their best-of-five quarters series at Ninoy Aquino Stadium. Rondae Hollis-Jefferson put up another big performance with 38 points, nine rebounds and three assists as the Tropang 5G delivered the knockout blow on the Hotshots with three convincing victories.
